## Fatal finding

1. **`monads-comonads-and-their-algebras` — page summary, line 68**

   The summary says: “Preorders turn monads and comonads into closure and interior operators.” This drops the essential poset qualification established by the assigned theorem.

   Evidence: [the theorem’s Statement](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-monads-on-a-preorder-are-exactly-closure-operators.md:26) calls the resulting map a closure operator only when the preorder is a poset; the comonad corollary makes the same distinction for interior operators.

   Counterexample: let \(P=\{0,1\}\) have the indiscrete preorder, so every \(x\le y\), and let \(T\) swap \(0\) and \(1\). Then \(T\) is monotone and satisfies \(p\le Tp\) and \(T^2p\le Tp\), so it defines a monad by the theorem. But
   \[
   T^2(0)=0\ne1=T(0),
   \]
   so \(T\) is not an idempotent map and therefore is not a literal closure operator. The same swap supplies the dual comonad counterexample.

   **Severity: fatal.** The public page prose contradicts the central preorder-versus-poset boundary preserved by the item titles and Statements.

No other fatal or reportable nonfatal defect was found in the 12 assigned item files.

## Boundary and provenance checks

- The fixed-object corollary correctly claims preorder equivalence in its title and literal equality only for posets; its proof obtains both \(p\le Tp\) and \(Tp\le p\).
- The free-monoid, free-group, and free-module arguments survive the empty generating set, trivial group, zero module, and zero-ring cases. The module theorem explicitly assumes a unital ring and left modules; no commutativity is used.
- The power-set monad uses direct image, proves both naturality squares, and its union laws include empty sets and empty families. The algebra theorem produces the empty supremum/least element. Exhaustive checks on carriers of sizes \(0,1,2,3\) found no violation.
- For ultrafilters, \(\beta\varnothing=\varnothing\), hence all empty-set components have empty domain. Flattening is an ultrafilter, naturality and all monad laws check out, and no ultrafilter lemma or choice principle is used. Exhaustive finite checks through size \(3\) found no violation.
- No assigned dependency has an `ai-generated` Statement or Construction.

## Coverage

Read fully: all 12 assigned items, both page files, and all 31 unique direct dependency items cited by the assignment. I sampled the batch proof contracts and research notes for boundary/provenance cross-checks. The linked external Riehl and Mac Lane PDFs could not be retrieved through the available browser, but every cited library dependency was opened and checked on disk.
